summary.en: One repo, four arcade classics: Asteroids, Lunar Lander, Space Invaders and Snake.
summary.zh: 一个仓库四个游戏：小行星、登月舱、太空侵略者、贪吃蛇。

description.en: Each game gets its own page and plays by arcade rules: fire retro-thrusters to set the lunar module down gently, while the rest use the controls you already know.
description.zh: 每个游戏一个独立页面，规则沿用经典街机：登月舱靠火箭反推软着陆，其余为常见街机操作。

tip.en: Four site entries for the price of one — outstanding value. The tutorial-style code shares one framework, so learning one game means you can rework all four.
tip.zh: 一次性给站点补 4 个条目，性价比极高。代码是教学风格，统一框架，改一个等于改四个。
